page.layout: One printed page with a large tree diagram (braced outline) filling the page, with a page number at the top centre and a catchword at the bottom right. No running head and no marginal notes.

main_text.l: Secundarium siue id, quod praeceptis additur, quod est vel
Primarium, vt in disciplinis Operatricibus, nam in his proprie sunt exempla.
Secundarium, vt in disciplinis contemplatiuis, siue scientiis nempe Metaphysicis, Physicis.
Concinnus, ne nimium breuis aut longus.
Distinctio. Est enim omnis commentarius vel
Methodum, si ratio methodi sit reddenda, quomodo praecepta cum praeceptis cohaereant.
Dubia & controuersias, quae circa praecepta oriuntur: quorum spectetur
De veritate & falsitate, cum quaeritur, an aliquid sit verum vel falsum, vt in scientiis.
An faciendum vel omittendum sit: qualia dubia in operatricibus disciplinis occurrunt.
Ex commentariis siue distinctio de limitatione.
Comparatus, vbi authoritates allegantur in quibus spectanda
Recte & fideliter citentur, libri ac capita expendantur ex emendatissimis exemplaribus.
Veterum testimonia priori & potiori loco ponantur, deinde recentium, sed nonnisi doctissimorum.
verbotenus citentur, si verba sint efficacia.
Referantur ad methodum praeceptorum & per praecepta explicentur.

page.notes: Diagram is a braced outline; levels are read from the braces, which are approximate given the faint show-through of the reverse page. Numerous words in the ghosted background from the other side of the leaf are omitted as show-through. Several lines near the centre are faint and some words are uncertain, notably "Simplex, quoad praeceptorum" and the level of "Comparatus". The bottom-left faint gathering mark is not clearly legible and is omitted.
